field-controlled.speaker: field
field-controlled.zh: 指挥中心，飞机保持漂浮，正在组织撤离。
field-controlled.en: Dispatch, aircraft afloat. Evacuation under way.

field-damaged.speaker: field
field-damaged.zh: 指挥中心，飞机有损伤，保持漂浮，请尽快接应。
field-damaged.en: Dispatch, aircraft damaged but afloat. Request assistance.

dispatch.speaker: dispatch
dispatch.zh: 水警三号、救援二组，前往河面接应。岸上救护待命。
dispatch.en: Marine three, rescue two, assist the aircraft. Medics stand by.

response.speaker: responder
response.zh: 水警三号收到，正在接近，准备接应。
response.en: Marine three copies. Approaching to assist.
